name: meridian-control-plane
description: A governed workflow control plane with a web console, API, worker, and PostgreSQL schema.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meridian/contracts && npm run build -w @meridian/core && npm run build -w @meridian/database && npm run build -w @meridian/api && npm run build -w @meridian/worker && npm run build -w @meridian/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @meridian/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/core && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/database && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/api && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/worker && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/web
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/__tests__/*.test.js packages/database/dist/__tests__/*.test.js apps/api/dist/__tests__/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/__tests__/*.test.js && npm run test -w @meridian/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck
